children: Mark Locke, a director and Chief Executive Officer, reported sales of ordinary shares in three transactions on September 15-17, 2026. The September 15 sale of 477,449 shares was at a weighted average price of $6.5751 per share (range $6.4663–$6.7219). The September 16 sale of 272,551 shares was at a weighted average price of $6.5648 per share (range $6.4998–$6.6795). The September 17 sale of 50,000 shares was at $6.541 per share. The total reported proceeds from the sales were $5,255,567. After these transactions, the reporting person directly owned 19,375,216 ordinary shares.
